title: Create a user without premature validation errors
steps: View the loaded Display settings page with the Origine theme selected.
Click Manage users in the admin navigation to reach the reauthentication prompt.
Enter the admin password and click Login to view Create new user without touching any of its fields.
After observing the untouched field, click Create with Username empty.
Enter bad name! in Username and click Create.
Correct Username to verifier9025 and press Tab to leave the field.
Enter a valid password and click Create; wait for the new account in the User list.

video_guide.summary: Inspect the initial Username border, then compare empty and malformed submissions, correction, and the resulting user list.

chapters.note: Display settings is open with the Origine theme selected.
The page displays Reauthentication is required.

Username has a red border and a Please fill out this field validation popup.

chapters.label: Enter bad name! and select Create

chapters.label: Replace the username with verifier9025 and leave the field

chapters.label: Enter a password and select Create

chapters.note: The User list includes verifier9025; the Username and Password inputs above are empty.
